facts.fact: AIIM and the Onix DC management team acquired 100% of Ngoya Etix DC (Ghana) Ltd, a carrier-neutral colocation data centre in Greater Accra with 170 racks, to be renamed Onix Accra #1, providing space, power, cooling and connectivity to customers; as_of is the article date, 4 March 2021.

The release states Onix Accra #1 (Ngoya Etix DC), operated by Onix Data Centres, is the only Tier IV data centre in Ghana, a claim by the acquirer and operator with no Uptime Institute certificate cited; as_of is the article date, 4 March 2021.
